decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core postpress offer, presented on its own page, fits the announced automation direction and draws on existing service and know-how, so the firm stays committed.

Although UV spot varnishing is distant from the core, the firm publicly staged the German premiere of the DuSense DDC-8000 at a customer event and featured it on the home page, and this visible commitment, together with enhancement being part of its stated portfolio, makes it persist.
The sheet preparation module builds on established systems as a modular component of automated workflows, so it costs little to keep and supports the strategic direction.
The B2 multifinisher was announced prominently on the home page as a new solution and is central to the firm's move toward automated multifinishing, so the firm is strongly committed to it.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is core booklet-making business with its own page and aligns with short-run digital finishing, so the firm keeps it.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation that enables inline single-pass production, which gives the firm evidence of success and fits its inline automation story.
